description: Unified Claude Code observability — cost, tokens, tools, projects, tickets, and Catalyst orchestration

panels.title: Tool Calls
panels.description: Fleet-wide total tool executions (claude_code_tool_result_total, OTL-21 connector). This connector metric carries only low-card resource labels (no project / branch / hostname / linear_key), so it does NOT narrow with the $project / $branch / $hostname filters — it is a fleet aggregate by design. Use the by-project / by-ticket tool panels (Loki) to slice.

panels.title: Spend by Host
panels.description: $ spent per time bucket, grouped by canonical host_name (falls back to the machine's hostname when host_name is not set). Shows which hosts are actively spending. Note: only hosts with the OTel context configured emit the canonical host_name (e.g. laptop); others appear under their FQDN.

panels.title: Tokens by Host
panels.description: Tokens consumed per time bucket, grouped by canonical host_name (falls back to hostname when host_name is not set). A liveliness view of per-host activity.

panels.title: Spend by Model
panels.description: $ spent per time bucket (width = Grafana $__interval, typically 15s-15m depending on zoom). Each point = actual cost attributed to that bucket.

panels.title: Tokens by Type
panels.description: Tokens consumed per time bucket (width = Grafana $__interval). Each point = actual tokens attributed to that bucket.

panels.title: Cache Savings ($)
panels.description: Estimated $ saved by cache hits (if cache reads were charged as input)

panels.title: Token Burn by Ticket (Top 10)
panels.description: Top 10 Linear tickets by token burn per time bucket (width = Grafana $__rate_interval). Excludes sessions with no linear_key attached.

panels.title: Token Burn by Project (Top 10)
panels.description: Top 10 projects by token burn per time bucket (width = Grafana $__rate_interval). Excludes sessions with no project attached.

panels.title: Unique Projects
panels.description: Total distinct project values in the selected time range. Bars above show top 10.

panels.title: Attribution Health
panels.description: OTL-67: Fraction of live claude_code_* series with no linear_key. Above 0.5 for 15m triggers the claude_code_attribution_missing alert. Healthy: 0 (all series attributed). See docs/runbook-otl-67-attribution.md.

targets.expr: topk by (account_email) (1, sum by (account_email, ratelimit_five_hour_resets_at) (count_over_time({service_name=~"catalyst.execution-core|catalyst.agent"} |= "account.ratelimit.sampled" | account_email!="" | ratelimit_five_hour_resets_at!="" [$__range])))

topk by (account_email) (1, sum by (account_email, ratelimit_seven_day_resets_at) (count_over_time({service_name=~"catalyst.execution-core|catalyst.agent"} |= "account.ratelimit.sampled" | account_email!="" | ratelimit_seven_day_resets_at!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Account Rate Limits — $account
panels.description: Per-account quota usage (5h / 7d / 7d-opus / 7d-sonnet). Repeats once per selected account so the few quota lines stay correlatable without cross-account overlap.

options.content:
### Hierarchical Execution (Coming Soon)

Execution-graph, Gantt, and treemap views are **blocked** pending CTL emission of:
`subagent_id`, `workflow_stage`, `parentSpanId`, `query_source`
(none currently emitted — see [research 2026-06-04-OTL-3](thoughts/shared/research/2026-06-04-OTL-3-catalyst-execution-telemetry-dashboard.md)).

**Intended queries once attributes are emitted:**

```promql
# Treemap cost by (linear_key → task_type → subagent_id)
sum by (linear_key, task_type, subagent_id) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{subagent_id=~".+"}[$__range]))
```

```logql
# Subagent-vs-main split via query_source
sum by (query_source) (count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | query_source=~".+" [$__range]))

# Gantt approximation by workflow_stage (min/max timestamps per stage)
count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | workflow_stage=~".+" [$__range])
```

_Blocked attributes not emitted: `subagent_id`, `workflow_stage`, `parentSpanId`, `query_source` — open a CTL emission ticket to unblock._

### Process by Role (CTL-1228, Forthcoming)

**Reserved for execution-core/monitor/broker/agent/claude/trunk CPU+mem + catalyst-vs-host proportion**

Planned visualization components:
- Per-process CPU and memory usage (execution-core, monitor, broker, agent, claude, trunk)
- Resource allocation breakdown by role
- Catalyst vs. host machine resource split
- Time series trends for capacity planning

_Status: Not yet implemented — awaiting instrumentation of process-level metrics via OTel resource.process.* and custom catalyst.process_role attributes._

### Process by Role (CTL-1228, Forthcoming)

**Reserved for per-process metrics:**

- CPU and memory by execution context
- Catalyst vs. host resource split
- Process timeline trends

_Awaiting emitted process_role and execution_context attributes._
